05 · Security and compliance
The agent can read, compute and propose. It cannot pay.
Money moves only with a human signature: one action, one payload hash, one step-
up token.
T0 READ Scoped, paged reads; documents marked untrusted AGENT
T1 CALC Forecast, what-if, pricing, stress test AGENT
T2 PROPOSE Validated plan or proposal; nothing runs AGENT
T3 APPROVE Bind one action to one payload hash OWNER
T4 EXECUTE Reserve funds and send to the bank WORKER
4 roles
Admin can stop sends, never approve
Kill switch
Resume only after reconciliation
12 risks
Published with severity and status
■ ROW-LEVEL SECURITY · NO SQL, SHELL OR PAYMENT TOOL FOR THE MODEL PAGE 11
